title: Experimental Demonstration of a Brachistochrone Nonadiabatic Holonomic Quantum-Gate Scheme in a Trapped Ion
summary: Nonadiabatic holonomic quantum computation (NHQC) offers intrinsic resilience to certain control imperfections. However, conventional nonadiabatic holonomic protocols are constrained by the fixed-pulse-area condition, which limits flexibility and prolongs duration of small-angle gates. Here we experimentally demonstrate a universal brachistochrone nonadiabatic holonomic quantum gate scheme in a trapped 40Ca+ ion, and realized the construction of pX gate under the conventional NHQC, brachistochrone NHQC (BNHQC) and composite BNHQC (CBNHQC) protocols.
